description: This PHP source file defines the Affiliate controller class for the account section in an OpenCart-based e-commerce platform. It handles rendering the affiliate information page and processing affiliate data submissions, including validation and interaction with models such as account/affiliate and account/custom_field.

classes.name: Affiliate
classes.description: Controller class for the affiliate page in the account section, extending the core Controller class, providing methods for viewing and saving affiliate info.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the affiliate page view with necessary data, including affiliate info, breadcrumbs, scripts, styles, and template output.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes POST requests to save or update affiliate information after validating user input and permissions. Returns JSON response with success or error messages.
